# Draft:Filmfare Award for Best Debut Director - South

The Filmfare Award for Best Debut Director - South is given by the Filmfare Magazine as part of its annual Filmfare Awards South for South Indian films. It acknowledges an encourages the filmmakers of an upcoming young talented directors. In 2023, Debut Director category has started.
